profile.name: Rupesh Nepal
profile.bio: Backend developer working across Python, Rust, and Go. Currently at Hyteno Tech maintaining backend systems for Morgenland Teppiche's 48,000+ product catalog across their webshop and marketplace integrations. Previously built the backend of a government project management system used in all 77 districts of Nepal (Shangrila Informatics) and a C2C beats marketplace (Ascend Crest Technologies). GNOME Nepal open source contributor.
profile.seoDescription: Backend developer specializing in Python, Rust and Go. Building scalable APIs, async systems, and open-source tools. GNOME Nepal contributor.

education.degree: Bachelor of Science in Computer Science and Information Technology (B.Sc. CSIT)

experience.highlight: Syncs 11,000+ SKUs across marketplaces and led the ERP migration from Plentymarkets to an in-house Django ERP.
details: Maintained a catalog of 48,000+ products live on Shopify (35,000+ in active stock), syncing a curated set of 11,000+ SKUs to eBay, Amazon, ManoMano, and Home24 through a Shopify to central database pipeline that serves as the single source of truth.

Implemented a monthly dynamic pricing strategy across webshop channels, varying discount percentages each month in line with the EU Omnibus Directive 30-day lowest-price rule, driving a 5-8% revenue increase.
Built automated product feeds for Google Shopping, Meta Catalog, and Pinterest Ads with rule-based dynamic product text, rule-driven custom labels, and channel-specific images for each feed pipeline.
Localized SKUs into 13 locales for new marketplace launches, and orchestrated catalog synchronization with Channable across 4+ sales channels.
Deployed and managed multiple production applications via Dokploy, reducing deployment overhead and improving operational visibility.
Led the ERP migration from Plentymarkets to an in-house ERP built on Django and DRF, migrating audited reports and warehouse data, the core functionality the business depends on.

experience.highlight: Backend for a government Project Management System used across all 77 districts of Nepal.
details: Developed the backend for a government Project Management System (PMS) used by district government offices in all 77 districts of Nepal, with Django and DRF form handling and REST APIs serving concurrent requests from government users.
Owned the analytics and Excel reporting module, mapping submitted form data into government-standardized Excel reports with predefined header templates and built-in formulas.
Migrated the legacy Django codebase to Django 4 with a clean, layered architecture, and streamlined the report generation pipeline.

Built the document validation flow in Celery background workers backed by Redis: a classifier scored each government document on logo and formatting match, auto-accepting documents at 60%+ confidence and routing the rest to manual review.

experience.highlight: Built BeatzBazar, a C2C beats marketplace with SoX audio watermarking, Stripe payments, and real-time WebSockets.
details: Built the backend for BeatzBazar, a C2C music beats marketplace, with Django REST Framework (DRF).

Implemented SoX-based audio watermarking for uncompressed WAV beats, overlaying a watermark beat every 10 seconds on preview copies so only licensed buyers receive the original file after purchase, protecting beats from piracy.

Integrated Stripe Checkout and webhooks for beat licensing, handling one-time purchases and license tiers, with a unique order ID sent as the idempotency key on every transaction to prevent duplicate charges.
Built real-time notifications and buyer-seller chat with Django Channels over WebSockets.
Ran all asynchronous background work, including audio processing, on Celery and Redis, with Celery Beat scheduling the analytics jobs.
Built a GitHub Actions CI/CD pipeline with flake8 linting and black formatting checks before deployment.

experience.highlight: Maintainer of GNOME Nepal's Django backend and contributor to Djate, a production-ready Django template.
details: Core contributor and maintainer of the GNOME Nepal backend system (Django).
Contributed to 'Djate', a production-ready Django project template used by the community.
Collaborated with open source contributors across Nepal to build and maintain community infrastructure.
Reviewed pull requests, triaged issues, and mentored new contributors to the Django ecosystem.
Taught students about Linux and the GNOME desktop as a workshop instructor.

experience.highlight: Operations Lead for UbuCon Asia 2025. Ran event operations and social media.
details: Led operations for UbuCon Asia 2025, hosted by Ubuntu Nepal.
Managed on-ground event operations across the multi-day conference.
Ran the event's social media campaign.

projects.name: Excel Product Import
projects.tech: Django, DRF, Celery, Redis, openpyxl, pandas
projects.description: Imports 10,000+ row Excel product files by splitting each upload into 100-row chunks processed in parallel by Celery workers with automatic retries. Validates every cell, logs null values and empty rows with per-import timing, normalizes 8 product attributes (brand, color, material, and more) into related tables, and serves import, export, and analytics through a Swagger-documented DRF API.
